name: mf_fno_incontext
description: In-context operator learning with NO fine-tune. A DeepSets encoder summarizes a few support pairs (X_i, Y_i) into a task context c; the FiLM FNO conditions on [X_query, c]. Trained EPISODICALLY on the abundant LF data (sample a support subset + disjoint query subset each step). At eval the HF TRAIN pairs are the support prompt and HF TEST inputs are the queries, so HF transfer happens purely in-context and the weights are never updated on HF. Backbone is the frozen FiLM FNO2d with cond_dim = X_dim + ctx_dim.
